product.seoTitle: Sufix 832 Advanced Superline Diameter & Reel Capacity Guide | ReelCalc
product.metaDescription: Check verified Sufix 832 Advanced Superline diameters and strength-specific packages. Plan a full reel fill or a working length over backing with the exact line diameter.
product.quickSummary: 832 combines seven HMPE fibers with one GORE Performance Fiber. The name refers to eight fibers and 32 weaves per inch. This is the U.S. Advanced Superline mainline, not 832 Ice Braid or the lead-core trolling product.
product.construction: Eight fibers: seven HMPE fibers and one GORE Performance Fiber; 32 weaves per inch
product.suitabilityTitle: Is 832 Advanced Superline right for your setup?
product.suitabilitySummary: Consider 832 when you want braid for the working line and a choice of short filler or large bulk packages. Its broad strength range does not make every size suitable for every reel: choose the rod and presentation first. A thin spinning setup may need substantial backing, while a heavier casting setup may consume most of a 150-yard package.

product.metaDescription: Check verified Sufix Elite diameters and strength-specific packages. Plan a full reel fill or a working length over backing with the exact line diameter.
product.quickSummary: Elite is Sufix's all-around monofilament with Micro Resin Technology. This guide includes the verified 4-20 lb U.S. rows. The heavier 25 and 30 lb package lengths conflict within the official source and are withheld.
product.construction: Monofilament with Sufix Micro Resin Technology
product.suitabilityTitle: Is Elite right for your setup?
product.suitabilitySummary: Elite is a candidate for a straightforward mono mainline or for backing beneath another working line. Its 330-yard filler options can cover a full fill on many smaller reels, but the amount depends on actual diameter. The 12 lb diameter is 0.014 inch in the current chart; do not substitute a generic 12 lb mono diameter when checking a reel.
strengthGuide: Compare 4-8 lb to the line range on a lighter rod, then check the reel. Lighter line on a larger-capacity spool may require more than you expect to reach the recommended fill level.
The chart increases from 10 lb at 0.012 inch to 12 lb at 0.014 inch. Treat that as a substantial capacity change, not just a two-pound step.
The verified 17 and 20 lb rows are 0.016 and 0.018 inch. On a small spinning spool, physical fit does not establish comfortable handling.

spoolingGuide.title: Start with the 330-yard filler
spoolingGuide.text: Calculate a full mono fill using the selected Elite row. Stop at the reel's recommended fill level and retain the remainder; a whole filler package need not go onto one reel.

spoolingGuide.title: Elite as backing
spoolingGuide.text: If Elite sits underneath braid or fluorocarbon, enter its exact diameter as the backing line and calculate with the actual working line. Do not confuse that arrangement with an Elite mainline fill.

faqs.question: Why are 25 and 30 lb missing?
faqs.answer: The official description says those strengths are 250 yards only, while current variant length fields say 330 yards. They are withheld until the package identity is resolved.

faqs.question: What is Micro Resin Technology?
faqs.answer: It is Sufix's named technology for Elite. Sufix attributes tensile and knot-strength benefits to it; this guide does not independently test those claims.

faqs.question: Does every Elite package use the same winding method?
faqs.answer: The official description and feature list disagree on which lengths receive G2 Precision Winding. This page does not extend that package-specific claim to the entire range.

faqs.question: How much Elite will fit my reel?
faqs.answer: Use the exact strength and the reel's published capacity. Pound test is not a fixed diameter, so equal-strength products can produce different fill estimates.

faqs.question: Is one 330-yard package enough?
faqs.answer: Only when it covers the planned working length and an appropriate reserve. Backing can fill unused volume, but cannot supply more working line for long casts, deep drops or fish runs.

product.quickSummary: Advance Mono combines HMPE with Sufix Hyper Copolymer. Despite the braid comparison in its slogan, it is sold as monofilament. product.construction: HMPE and Hyper Copolymer combination, sold by Sufix as monofilament
product.suitabilityTitle: Is Advance Mono right for your setup?

strengthGuide: The current 6, 8 and 10 lb rows are 0.010, 0.011 and 0.012 inch. Those values differ from many braids with similar pound labels, despite the product's braid-themed slogan.
At 12 and 14 lb, the listed diameters rise to 0.014 and 0.015 inch. Check compact spinning-reel handling as well as the calculated space.
The 17-25 lb sizes belong in a setup chosen for the lure, cover and rod rating. The availability of a 1,200-yard package does not imply a need to spool that much.

spoolingGuide.title: Calculate it as Advance Mono
spoolingGuide.text: Use the listed Advance Mono diameter rather than a braid-equivalent pound test. The manufacturer's slogan does not change the line volume calculation.

spoolingGuide.text: At 4-20 lb, compare 330-yard fillers with 1,200-yard bulk supply. At 25 lb, only the separate 1,200-yard SKUs are verified here: filler length fields say 330 yards while their image labels say 250 yards. Those filler packages are withheld pending clarification.

spoolingGuide.title: Keep fill level conservative
spoolingGuide.text: Wind evenly and stop at the reel manufacturer's recommended lip clearance. Lower-stretch positioning is not permission to overfill or to ignore the rod's line range.

faqs.question: Does it need a separate ice calculator?
faqs.answer: Capacity still depends on physical diameter. The important practical difference is planning depth and reserve within a short 55-yard package, not assuming an open-water casting-length plan.

faqs.question: How much Hybrid Ice Line will fit my reel?

faqs.question: Is one 55-yard package enough?

faqs.question: What does the ninth strand do?
faqs.answer: Yo-Zuri describes eight PE strands around a straight PE core and attributes durability and handling benefits to that structure. ReelCalc has not independently tested those performance claims.

faqs.question: Are White and Dark Green offered in identical sizes?
faqs.answer: No. The official tables show different upper strengths and filler combinations. Use the exact package rows.

faqs.question: Why is the 100 lb bulk option absent?
faqs.answer: The White bulk row's item code and strength column say 100 lb, but its description says 65 lb. The unambiguous 100 lb/300 yd row is retained; the conflicting bulk package is not.

faqs.question: How much SuperBraid 9 will fit my reel?
faqs.answer: Use the exact strength and the reel's published capacity. Pound test is not a fixed diameter, so equal-strength products can produce different fill estimates.

faqs.question: Is one 150-yard package enough?
faqs.answer: Only when it covers the planned working length and an appropriate reserve. Backing can fill unused volume, but cannot supply more working line for long casts, deep drops or fish runs.
